mapper.select: SELECT id, code_mac, key_id, sent_at, expires_at, consumed_at, failed_attempts FROM email_verification_codes WHERE purpose = #{purpose} AND email = #{email} AND subject_key = #{subjectKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification_codes (purpose, user_id, email, code_mac, key_id, sent_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{purpose}, #{userId}, #{email}, #{codeMac}, #{keyId}, #{sentAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification_codes SET code_mac = #{codeMac}, key_id = #{keyId}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, consumed_at = NULL, failed_attempts = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE email_verification_codes SET failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE email_verification_codes SET consumed_at = #{consumedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
